confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Rome prices. The price search returned Numbeo-based figures (Expatica, June 2026) and HousingAnywhere guides. I converted euro prices at roughly 1.16 USD per EUR, which is my assumption. Restaurant meals, coffee and beer come from those aggregates. The cocktail figure is about EUR 12 from HousingAnywhere. I found no clear restaurant wine-glass price, so I set it at about EUR 6, in line with the beer price. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates for peak July demand, not live listings, so they are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Rome price aggregates, with accommodation set against typical major Western European tourist capitals in peak summer.
